mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_logs (user_medicine_id, scheduled_time, taken_time, dosage_taken, status, source, create_time) VALUES (#{userMedicineId}, #{scheduledTime}, #{takenTime}, #{dosageTaken}, #{status}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ml.*, COALESCE(um.custom_name, mi.name) as medicine_name, um.dose_unit FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND ml.status = 'pending' ORDER BY ml.scheduled_time ASC

SELECT ml.*, COALESCE(um.custom_name, mi.name) as medicine_name, um.dose_unit, um.reminder_times FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(ml.scheduled_time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY ml.scheduled_time ASC

SELECT ml.*, um.custom_name as medicine_name, um.dose_unit FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id WHERE ml.user_medicine_id = #{userMedicineId} AND DATE(ml.scheduled_time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY ml.scheduled_time ASC

SELECT ml.*, um.custom_name as medicine_name, um.dose_unit, um.reminder_times FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id WHERE ml.user_medicine_id = #{userMedicineId} AND ml.scheduled_time = #{scheduledTime} AND ml.status IN ('pending', 'missed') LIMIT 1

SELECT ml.*, um.custom_name as medicine_name, um.dose_unit FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id WHERE ml.user_medicine_id = #{userMedicineId} AND ml.scheduled_time = #{scheduledTime} AND ml.status IN ('taken', 'taken_early', 'taken_makeup') ORDER BY ml.taken_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ml.*, um.custom_name as medicine_name, um.dose_unit FROM medication_logs ml LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON ml.user_medicine_id = um.id WHERE ml.user_medicine_id = #{userMedicineId} AND ml.status = 'taken' AND ml.taken_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ml.taken_time DESC LIMIT 1
